thread:
samir: Morning — dropping today's CVE intake summary, please quick triage and owners.
- CVE-2025-4821 | protobufjs | CVSS 7.5 | EPSS 0.62 | PoC chatter on github issues :eyes:
- CVE-2026-0112 | lodash | CVSS 9.8 | EPSS 0.02 | no public PoC yet
- CVE-2025-9900 | grpcio | CVSS 6.5 | EPSS 0.01 | small PoC in private exploit repo (unconfirmed)
Context: web-api (Node16, uses protobufjs for ingest), search-svc (Python, grpcio), ui-lib (npm, lodash). Prioritize based on exploitability + exposure.

sec-bot: Auto-enrichment results:
- CVE-2025-4821: NVD link https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-4821 | CWE-20 | Affected versions <7.0.1 | Known active scans in the wild
- CVE-2026-0112: high severity, but EPSS low; no confirmed exploit chains for our stack
- CVE-2025-9900: exploit PoC flagged as "limited"; requires specific grpc configs we mostly don't use

elaine: Protobufjs one looks risky for ingestion pipeline. web-api accepts uploaded protos and we parse them server-side. Recommend: immediate upgrade on web-api to patched protobufjs 7.0.1, add runtime input validation as mitigation if upgrade risks are high.
- Owner: elaine
- Suggested priority: P1 (hotpatch/canary)

josh: I can do lodash audit across packages. Quick `npm ls lodash` shows a few transitive deps in ui-lib. If lodash requires major bump, we might schedule normal patch release (P2) unless PoC appears.
- Owner: josh

tara: grpcio: our search-svc uses grpcio but behind internal ACLs. Ops confirmed no public endpoints. Suggest score P3 for now, but put on watchlist and add e2e repro attempt in the triage runbook.
- Owner: tara

samir: Triage notes consolidated:
- CVE-2025-4821 (protobufjs): P1, hotpatch on web-api, canary deploy, add input validation and rate-limit for proto upload route. Create SEC ticket SEC-2025-347. Backport to 1.8 LTS if patch is non-breaking.
- CVE-2026-0112 (lodash): P2, schedule in next minor release, audit transitive deps, open SEC-2026-055.
- CVE-2025-9900 (grpcio): P3 watchlist, repro attempt + risk assessment, SEC-2025-9900-WATCH.

samir: Quick commands to run for owners: 
```
# get EPSS and CVSS programmatically
curl -s "https://api.first.org/data/v1/cve/CVE-2025-4821" | jq '.data[0].vuln?'
# npm audit skeleton
npm audit --json > /tmp/audit.json
```

elaine: Will open SEC-2025-347 with the patch plan and attach a minimal test. Target ETA: 24h for canary PR. If runtime validation is easy, I'll include it in same PR.

josh: Starting npm dependency sweep now, will post results in thread and link PRs.

ops-bot: Deploy window: next canary slot available at 2025-06-12T03:00Z. Auto-rollback on >2% error delta.

tara: For the watchlist grpcio repro, I have a stub to try in my sandbox later today. If I see exploitability, will escalate to P1.

samir: Good. Action items: elaine -> hotpatch + validation, josh -> dependency sweep, tara -> repro attempt. I'll shepherd tickets and schedule canary. :thumbsup:

josh: ack :thumbsup:
elaine: ack :thumbsup:
tara: ack :+1:
